hooks.text: 键盘上的每个字母都承载不可预测的魔法，组合成单词后直接化为攻防手段。
hooks.excerpt: Your keyboard is your arsenal. Your words are your weapons. Tomb of the Bloodletter is a strategic word roguelike where each letter of your keyboard channels unpredictable Magicks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 异端者、冒险者、学者和先知各有扭曲规则的特性与能力，改变战斗思路。
hooks.excerpt: Whether you play as the Heretic, Adventurer, Scholar, or Prophet, every character brings quirks and abilities that twist the rules of the game and change your approach to combat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每层开局先造词决定前进路线，在强化、治疗和重掷变化等房间之间取舍。
hooks.excerpt: At the start of each floor, you’ll craft a word to form your path. Choose between rooms that strengthen your arsenal, restore your health, or twist your Magick rerolls.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
